title: Add admin tracking number field for orders and show payment instruction notification after order submission

requirements.text: Extend the backend Order model to store an optional tracking number, and expose it via existing order query methods (getOrder, getAllOrders).

quotes: Add a area for admin to add a tracking number to orders when they’re no longer pending

acceptanceCriteria: Each order returned by getOrder and getAllOrders includes a tracking number field (optional/nullable).
Existing order creation continues to work without requiring a tracking number.

requirements.text: Add a backend admin-only method to set/update an order’s tracking number, and enforce that a tracking number can only be set when the order status is not pending (i.e., approved or shipped).

quotes: Add a area for admin to add a tracking number to orders when they’re no longer pending

acceptanceCriteria: A new admin-only backend function exists to update an order’s tracking number by orderId.
If the order is pending, the backend rejects the tracking-number update with an error.
If the order is approved or shipped, the backend stores the provided tracking number and subsequent reads return it.
Non-admin callers cannot update tracking numbers.

requirements.text: Update the Admin Panel UI to let admins add/edit a tracking number per order, only when the order is no longer pending, and persist the change to the backend with success/error feedback.

quotes: Add a area for admin to add a tracking number to orders when they’re no longer pending

acceptanceCriteria: For each order in the admin orders list, there is a tracking number input/display area.
When an order status is pending, the tracking number input is hidden or disabled with a clear UI indication that tracking is available only after pending.
When an order status is approved or shipped, the admin can save/update the tracking number and receives a success toast on completion and an error toast on failure.
After saving, the Admin Panel reflects the updated tracking number without a manual refresh (via React Query invalidation/refetch).

requirements.text: Show the tracking number on the Order Details page when it exists.

quotes: Add a area for admin to add a tracking number to orders

acceptanceCriteria: If the order has a tracking number, Order Details displays it in a readable field/section.
If the order has no tracking number, Order Details does not show a misleading empty value.

requirements.text: After a user successfully submits an order, display a notification popup with the exact text: "Please contact the owner for payment methods".

quotes: after someone submits, an order make it so a notification will pop up saying, please contact the owner for payment methods

acceptanceCriteria: On successful order creation, the UI shows a notification/toast that reads exactly: "Please contact the owner for payment methods".
The notification appears after a successful submission (not on validation errors or backend failures).
The existing success flow (e.g., navigation to the dashboard) still occurs.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing payment processing or collecting payment details inside the app.
Adding real-time notifications beyond the post-submit popup/toast.
Integrating third-party shipping APIs or tracking lookups.
